config.selection: For each run, minimize validation per-axis-normalized natural error plus lambda times even-head response error. Include step zero. Freeze all checkpoints and report the full grid before collecting test. No best-test selection.
config.objective: Natural error is estimated using half the squared difference between independently sampled natural-state errors, divided by discovery variance per output. This exactly targets mean-calibrated error in expectation. Responses use exact mean-state linear term and approximate quadratic term, divided by even-head discovery response mean square per output. Analytic scalar intercept uses original natural discovery only.
config.budget: One global symmetric rank-r quadratic per scalar, learned factors U and signed coefficients w (signs can change), one exact linear read and one calibrated constant. Four scalar programs have at most 4(r+1) reads, not a shared r-dimensional module. Stored learned parameters 4*(1152*r+r+1152+1), plus shared mean. Full exact matrices are training/evaluation oracle only.

discriminators.objective: Response-weighted models improve held-out-head fidelity by >=0.10 over corresponding spectral baseline while natural R2 loses <=0.05, in both initializations at a rank.
discriminators.source_generalization: Compare training, validation-even, test-even, and test-odd response errors; an even-only gain suggests limited source transfer.
discriminators.capacity: Compare rank 32/64/128 curves within objective and initialization; do not infer a hard rank lower bound from optimizer failure.
discriminators.optimization: Report step-zero, final training and validation, selected step, initialization spread, and losses. Two nearby initializations are a limited stability check, not exhaustive optimization.
discriminators.payload_generalization: Test odd-head Gaussian and isotropic norm-matched payloads, plus half and paired removals. No fitting to these families.

config.scope: Four fixed L8 output coordinates, local coefficient changes only. Text panels disjoint in this continuation, not globally unused. Rank and objective grid provide discriminating measurements, not independent hypothesis-confirmation counts.
